notes.title: MSI Electric City: Core Assault Performance/Bug Update Released
notes.content:
Release notes:
[list]
[*]Optimizations for all quality settings.
[*]Lowest quality graphics setting has further reductions for improved performance.
[*]Added fix for Oculus Touch controller positioning.
[*]Update that will reduce potential ‘LowLevelFatalError’ crash error.
[*]Disabled graphic options that were causing rendering issues on some AMD video cards.
[*]VRWorks options have been moved to beta branch ‘vrworks’ that can be accessed by opting in beta branch. 
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Added fix for Oculus Touch controller positioning.

[*]Disabled graphic options that were causing rendering issues on some AMD video cards.

notes.title: Introducing MSI Electric City: Core Assault VR Bullet Hell Game
notes.content:
[h1]Rediscover MSI Electric City with the Best VR Ready Motherboard[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30583483/3e567b3d02b26e46e5ae5983ca666586ebd4118f.jpg[/img]

MSI brings an extremely realistic virtual reality experience to VR gamers with the latest release MSI Electric City: Core Assault VR Bullet Hell arcade shoot ’em up! Being the leader in the gaming industry, MSI released the first ever VR experience advertisement – MSI Electric City in 2016, taking players into a futuristic motherboard city with detailed lights and shades, magnificent scenery and architecture, and garnering more than 70,000 owners on Steam.

This year, MSI is excited to introduce MSI Electric City: Core Assault, sequel to MSI Electric City. The city is now under assault from hostile enemies bent on destroying the main core. Players are in control of a fighter spacecraft with the mission to defend the core and surrounding tower defense structures. Maneuver and blast away your enemies in this third person VR arcade action shooter. More about the game: http://vr.msi.com/event/2017/electric-city

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30583483/96191567e144e44abe057566dc83050a934a14a4.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30583483/04dc7efc2efd3911cdbf8cfc4abd874c86a9cd0e.jpg[/img]

[b]PREP YOURSELF FOR THE BEST VR GAMING[/b]
Want the best of the best VR game experience without any compromise? Equipped with VR Boost, a smart chip that ensures a clean and strong signal to a VR optimized USB port, MSI VR Ready motherboards provide users an enjoyable VR experience. Also, by closely working with the industries’ leading VR headset vendors, we make sure you get the best possible gaming experience when choosing Virtual Reality. 

To learn more about the game, head over to the MSI Electric City landing page here: http://vr.msi.com/event/2017/electric-city

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30583483/40ffe591aeba7dfd548ed0f0acdf701c4d7faab2.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30583483/2282bf268a661eabd20c04e30acb12aaa43491c7.jpg[/img]

[b]ABOUT MSI GAMING[/b]
As a world leading gaming brand, MSI's aim is to become the most trusted name in gaming and eSports. We stand by our principles of breakthroughs in design, the pursuit of excellence, and technological innovation as we have continued to raise the bar for ourselves and have accomplished a great deal of pioneering work in the industry. For more product information, please visit www.msi.com.
